title: Gauss-Green identity for a Lipschitz scalar test function times a constant vector (Simon (3); parent Step 3)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, G ⊆ ℝ^N Lebesgue null-measurable, and (μ, ν) a Gauss-Green pair for (U, G) (IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν). Let ζ : ℝ^N → ℝ be K-Lipschitz (K ∈ ℝ≥0) with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ U, and let w ∈ ℝ^N. Then ∫_{G∩U} Dζ(y)w dL^N(y) = −∫ ζ(y)⟨w, ν(y)⟩ dμ(y), where Dζ(y) := fderiv ℝ ζ y (the Fréchet derivative where it exists and 0 elsewhere).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U G : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet G volume → IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν → ∀ (ζ : Rn N → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ w : Rn N, ∫ y in G ∩ U, fderiv ℝ ζ y w = -∫ y, ζ y * inner ℝ w (ν y) ∂μ
